Manifest.Name: Platonic's Recipes
Manifest.Description: 47 whispers from Platonic's enchanted kitchen, featuring original assets by Macskasajt/Platoniccat. Their recipes simmer with magic and memory, now ladled by Gus into bowls at the Saloon—each bite a story, each meal a doorway to worlds beyond the valley. Rekindled lovingly for Stardew Valley 1.6 with balanced pricing, i18n support, and all the wonder intact. Taste the legends. 🔥
Manifest.Author: KennethFiel
